Priya Kapoor: Quick check — offer accepted for Senior PM (IC5). Candidate wants start date Jun 1 but has pre-booked family travel Jun 10-24. They asked if benefits can start Jun 1 and if the sign-on can be deferred until after travel.
Daniel Lewis: Can manager confirm headcount and whether compensation is within band? If above midpoint we'll need approval route.
Omar Reyes: Manager here. Headcount is approved. Offer comp below. No team ramp conflicts.
Priya Kapoor: Paste comp: 
```
Base: $195,000
Sign-on: $15,000 (single payment)
Band: IC5 (B-IC5-NA)
Location: Remote - NY
```
Kara Lin: IC5 midpoint is $190k. Offer at +2.6% — small uplift. I can approve manager-backed uplift under $10k without committee.
Priya Kapoor: Candidate requested sign-on payment after travel (around Jul 1). Is that operationally okay? Would payroll need a special note?
Payroll Bot: @Priya FYI — benefits effective on official start date. Sign-on payment date can be set later but requires a payroll request with signed offer and payment memo to payroll@redwood. Delaying payment does not change tax year rules; confirm with Finance for cashflow.
Omar Reyes: Manager approves delayed sign-on payout to Jul 1. Candidate will still be active employee during travel (on approved paid time off).
Daniel Lewis: Kara approved comp uplift. Please add a one-line justification in the record (senior PM with cross-functional product infra experience). No comp committee needed.
Priya Kapoor: Noted — logging: "IC5 +2.6% manager-approved; sign-on deferred to Jul 1 by payroll request."
Kara Lin: Also flag that benefits start date is Jun 1 in HR systems. If candidate is traveling internationally, legal may need to check cross-border payroll implications. cc @Legal.
Priya Kapoor: Candidate confirmed. I'll open payroll ticket and attach signed offer + note: "pay sign-on on Jul 1 per candidate request; benefits start Jun 1."
Omar Reyes: Onboarding plan: start Jun 1 with remote orientation; buddy will coordinate asynchronous trainings Jun 10-24.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
